selection_basis: Capacity metadata only; no move labels, position rows, or prior style scores were read.
selection_order: Ascending SHA256(seed:casefolded_player) among players with at least 500 eligible strict_3_0 games; first 20 selected.
whole_game_rule: For each selected player, use the newest 500 eligible unique whole games ordered by played_at then game_id; reject tied chronological split boundaries.
evidence_limit: This is a development-only prototype cohort. These local players were involved in prior v1 work, so its evaluation split is not fresh independent confirmation and cannot promote the model.
